proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger.takes_damage
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature fits the existing class_feature activation family with a reaction cost, but the current ReactionTrigger union cannot express a generic trigger that opens when the ranger takes damage.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you take damage, you can take a Reaction

proposed_widenings.name: Duration.until_end_of_current_turn
proposed_widenings.justification: The resistance rider persists only through the current turn. The current Duration union can express rounds, concentration, permanence, and some early-end triggers, but not a turn-local duration anchored to the current turn rather than the user's next turn or a full round.
proposed_widenings.evidence: until the end of the current turn

notes: The top-level shape is still an honest class_feature activation: reaction-costed self-target effect granting resistance to the triggering damage type via existing EffectAtom.grant_resistance with damageType = { kind: "triggering_damage_type" }. I did not author content because the missing trigger and duration variants would force a misleading placeholder.
